summary: This note describes Hints Allegations and Things Left Unsaid, the debut studio album by the American rock band Collective Soul. The album was first released in 1993 on Atlanta indie label Rising Storm Records. The single "Shine" drew attention to the band through college radio, and the band later signed with Atlantic Records, which issued the album on CD in 1994.
one_line: Debut studio album by American rock band Collective Soul, first released on Atlanta indie label Rising Storm Records in 1993.
